title: Wilke volunteer: L4-L5 IDP lifting a 19.8 kg crate with a round flexed back
condition: stoop lift, legs almost straight, 19.8 kg crate in both hands

quantity.name: IDP
quantity.definition: absolute in vivo intradiscal pressure in the nucleus (MPa), peak/plateau value for the posture

source.authors: Wilke HJ, Neef P, Hinz B, Seidel H, Claes L
source.sample: 1 subject (male volunteer); 1 healthy male volunteer (orthopaedist), non-degenerated L4-L5 disc; telemetric piezoresistive transducer (1.5 mm) in the nucleus; original measurements Wilke et al. 1999 Spine 24:755

protocol.summary: Single healthy male volunteer, telemetric pressure transducer in L4-L5 nucleus, ~24 h recording at 300 Hz; postures/exercises self-performed; values are the peak or plateau of the recorded pressure curve.
how_to_simulate: Scale the model to the subject in protocol.subject_model (sex, age, height, body mass; see weight_which_applies)
Posture: Flex the trunk 70 deg (U01 Table 1 task 6 static reconstruction) with knees almost straight; arms hanging vertically
Hand load: 19.8 kg total (crate 300 x 400 x 300 mm), 9.9 kg in each hand, hands hanging below the shoulders
Output: L4-L5 disc compression F (axial, along the disc-normal / upper-vertebra axis) and L4-L5 intersegmental flexion th relative to upright standing
Convert with Ghezelbash 2016 BMMB Eq. 6: P = F / A with A = 1800 mm2 (Wilke 2001); IDP = Eq. 6(P, th) (see protocol.notes); compare with data[].mean

subject_model.height_source: 174 cm (Wilke 1999 / V05 Table 2; Wilke 2001 Appendix A measured 173.9 cm about 2.5 yr later). Wilke 2001 Appendix A 'Body height 173.9 cm' (measured by the authors ~2.5 yr after the IDP study); Wilke 1999 self-reported ~174 cm (Dreischarf 2016 V05 Table 2: 174 cm)
subject_model.disc_area_source: Wilke 2001 p.S112 Sec 2.2 and p.S119: L4-5 disc area 18 cm2 from the mid-horizontal MRI scan taken 4 weeks before the IDP measurements (same in Rohlmann 2001 Ergonomics p.784 '1800 mm2' and V05 Table 2 '18.0 cm2'). Wilke 2001 also gives anthropometric predictions 19.36 cm2 (from body mass) and 23.97 cm2 (from stature and joint diameters) - not used.
subject_model.other: Full anthropometry (trunk segments standing/sitting, 60+ body dimensions, skinfolds) in Wilke 2001 Tables 1-2 and Appendix A; 50th-percentile German male (45-49 y), active body mass 63.5 kg, fat 8.5 kg (p.S119).
subject_model.level: L4-L5 (transducer in the centre of the non-degenerated L4-5 nucleus)

protocol.idp_conversion: IDP = -1.556e-2 + 1.255 P + 1.243e-2 th + 3.988e-2 P^2 - 1.212e-2 P th + 1.669e-3 th^2 (MPa), P = F_compression / A_disc (MPa = N/mm2), th = L4-L5 intersegmental flexion from upright standing (deg, + flexion). Source: Ghezelbash et al. 2016 Biomech Model Mechanobiol 15:1699, Eq. 6 (U01 p.10; quadratic fit to the Shirazi-Adl 2006 L4-L5 FE model, R2 0.999, RMSE 0.025 MPa; derived with that model's disc area 1455 mm2, applied with the subject's own area); used again as Eq. 1-2 in Ghezelbash et al. 2020 J Biomech 102:109550 and in the Ghezelbash lab MSK validation. Sensitivity alternative: classical Nachemson factor IDP = F / (0.66 A) (Bruno et al. 2015 J Biomech Eng Eq. 2; Dreischarf 2016 V05 uses F = 0.66 IDP A).
protocol.notes: Peak during a dynamic lift; the static 70 deg reconstruction (Arjmand 2011 / U01) is what the Ghezelbash lab model simulates.

data.x: bent over (round back), legs almost straight, holding 19.8 kg; 70 deg trunk flexion in U01
data.load: 19.8 kg crate (30x40x30 cm) in both hands

extraction.from: Wilke 2001 p.S115 Sec 3.1.2 ('Lifting the case by bending over with the legs almost straight increased the pressure up to 2.3 MPa', Fig 3(b)); abstract; posture 70 deg from U01 Table 1 task 6
extraction.uncertainty: peak value of a dynamic lift; static 70 deg posture is a reconstruction
extraction.check_notes: Primary 2.3 MPa; U01 Fig 5 re-digitised 2.302 MPa; targets 2.3. Crate mass 19.8 kg and dimensions 300x400x300 mm from p.S115. | verified 2026-11-12 independent check: OK (Wilke 2001 abstract and p.S115: lifting 19.8 kg crate bent over with round back up to 2.3 MPa) | 2026-11-12: subject weight set to 72 kg (user decision).

pass_rule.rule: pass if |model - measured| <= max(SD or half-range, 0.26 x measured); pooled over all L4-L5 tasks R2 >= 0.78 with slope 95% CI containing 1 and intercept CI containing 0
pass_rule.source: Ghezelbash lab validation targets tolerance_policy.idp_task / idp_aggregate (CV_pool 0.26 = pooled between-subject CV of Sato 1999's 8 healthy subjects)
